name: Some Guy
description:
Your every day me.
I'm \N[1].

name: Fucking Oni
description:
When everyone perceives me as a fucking oni, I get the job done.
Just gotta be aggressive as fuck, and stomp on them like a demon.

name: Raving Lunatic
description:
I do not need to think, I will just give into that pulling urge I feel constantly.
I will become one with my favorite household appliance: the blender.

name: Painbringer
description:
I will decimate ALL foes with my overcompensating weaponry, and also use
the magic of misery to bend all foes into submission.

name: "Quicksilver"
description:
This likely only as fast as necessary to qualify as "quicksilver", which is fast enough.
My goal here is "don't be close", which should be easy to adhere to with this class.

name: Just Enough
description:
Taken to the next level, I'll be the absolute masterclass in "stay away and poke".
Catastrophic damage awaits those who dare draw near me.

name: Try-Hard
description:
THIS IS IT, FUCK THEM, I WILL REWIND THEIR FUCKING SOULS UNTIL THEY STOP EXISTING.
GOD DAMNIT WHY DID THAT TAKE TWO HITS?

name: Contemptuous
description:
Ugh, what a hassle. Just use a fucking shotgun and stand right near the door for a quick exit.
Foes can't handle dozens of bullets at once, so the job is easier this way.

name: Medick
description:
I can't believe you're going to make me do support things, omg.
Let it be known I will do only the barest minimum to support \N[2].

name: Orbiter
description:
I guess if I'm gonan support, I may as well get good at being a hard ass meat shield.
\N[2] needs space? I'll give him space to get his shit done.

name: Malpractician
description:
After a bit of practice, I've found some really mean ways to do some "support" things.
Anti-support, really. Enemy diagnosis is Death.

name: Transcendant
description:
I was given the world and I have shown the world that nothing can stop me.
I have transcended to the ultimate form, and become the the embodiment of destruction.

name: Know-it-all
description:
Fairly average guy who knows a lot.
I am \N[2].

name: Strategist
description:
Proving my specialty being strategy is the easy part.
Now just gotta blow em up with big booms and magic orbs...

name: Lavos
description:
Hehehe, HAHAHAHA.
ALL shall bow before my FIERY MIGHT! I am the ender of time, LAVOS!

name: Melufa
description:
Calculated and coordinated strikes of varying intensities and elements is my bread and butter.
If they can't hit me, does that make me unstoppable?

name: The Architect
description:
All is according to plan. Here, there, everywhere.
This is child's play. Now be a good minion and die.

name: Debilitator
description:
Not everything needs to end in fiery doom to lead to despair.
Allow me to show you other ways foes can suffer.

name: Methodical Dismantler
description:
If I take it one step at a time, I can basically dismember foes without them even knowing!
First the wings... then the shell... and then evaporate their aura... and they are a sitting duck.

name: Equilibrium
description:
Keeping the balance of the universe is essential.
Mostly that translates to bolstering us while extracting from them- balanced in our favor!

name: Fate
description:
This is it, I decide where the die lands.
Spoiler: it always lands in a way complimentary to us.

name: RNGesus
description:
I command the threads of fate entirely, plucking and snipping the strings at a whim.
Finding us luckier than ever never turned out to be so... fun!

name: Hexagonal
description:
It is impossible to not see me for the curse-weaver that I am.
In fact, it is pretty difficult to not see me, period.

name: Omniscient
description:
I have strategized and woven the threads of fate into the ultimate tapestry of perfection.
I am everywhere and know all there is to know to ensure your absolution.
